description:
A Chinese spyware GPS system app, consider removing if your phone doesn't have a GPS sensor.
This app is developed by a company called Zhantang, the same organization that made a dropper malware (com.redstone.ota.ui):
https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2021/04/pre-installed-auto-installer-threat-found-on-android-mobile-devices-in-germany
https://thehackernews.com/2021/04/pre-installed-malware-dropper-found-on.html
